methodology_note: Estimates compiled from CBO scores, OMB projections, GAO reports, and credible news analysis. All figures are approximate and represent projected costs/savings over the stated time horizon. Per-taxpayer figures based on ~153 million individual tax filers (IRS 2023).

14148.title: Initial Rescissions of Harmful Executive Orders and Actions
14148.source: OMB estimate; regulatory rollback savings are speculative
14148.methodology: OMB projected savings from reversing Biden-era regulatory actions. Actual savings depend on which regulations are formally repealed vs. simply unenforced.

14151.title: Ending Radical and Wasteful Government DEI Programs and Preferencing
14151.source: OPM staffing data; GAO federal program analysis
14151.methodology: Savings from eliminating DEI offices across federal agencies (~$680M/yr in staffing and programs). Costs include severance, legal challenges, and reorganization ($350M one-time).

14153.title: Unleashing Alaska's Extraordinary Resource Potential
14153.source: CBO energy development scoring; DOI lease estimates
14153.methodology: Federal costs for environmental review fast-tracking, infrastructure support for Arctic drilling. Revenue from lease sales ($1.2B projected) not counted as 'savings' — goes to general fund.

14154.title: Unleashing American Energy
14154.source: CBO energy regulation scoring; EIA projections
14154.methodology: Savings from reduced regulatory compliance costs passed through to consumers. Costs include foregone environmental protections, increased health externalities (EPA estimates), and permitting infrastructure.

14155.title: Withdrawing the United States From the World Health Organization
14155.source: WHO assessed contributions; State Dept budget
14155.methodology: US annual assessed contribution to WHO was ~$693M. Voluntary contributions (~$500M additional) were already frozen. Savings are direct and immediate.

14156.title: Declaring a National Energy Emergency
14156.source: CRS emergency powers analysis; historical emergency spending
14156.methodology: Emergency declarations unlock discretionary spending authority. Estimated costs based on expedited permitting, emergency infrastructure projects, and military deployment for energy security. Highly uncertain — depends on how broadly emergency powers are exercised.

14158.title: Establishing and Implementing the President's "Department of Government Efficiency"
14158.source: DOGE claimed $2T savings; CBO/GAO realistic estimate far lower
14158.methodology: DOGE claimed $2T in savings. Independent analysis suggests actual realizable savings of $55B over 10 years from contract renegotiations, IT modernization, and headcount reduction. Setup costs include new office infrastructure, staffing, and technology. The gap between claims and realistic projections is enormous.

14159.title: Protecting the American People Against Invasion
14159.source: DHS budget analysis; ICE detention cost data
14159.methodology: Mass deportation operations: ICE detention at ~$150/day/person × projected 500,000 detainees = $27.4B. Offset by existing DHS budget allocation. Additional costs for expanded border patrol, military deployment, and legal proceedings.

14160.title: Protecting the Meaning and Value of American Citizenship
14160.source: DOJ litigation cost estimates; CRS birthright citizenship analysis
14160.methodology: Extensive legal challenges (multiple federal courts have blocked implementation). DOJ litigation costs, state compliance costs, and administrative restructuring of citizenship verification systems.

14162.title: Putting America First in International Environmental Agreements
14162.source: Paris Agreement contribution commitments; State Dept climate finance
14162.methodology: Withdrawing from Paris Agreement eliminates US climate finance commitments (~$4.2B pledged over 5 years). Does not account for potential trade retaliation, carbon border adjustments by EU, or long-term climate damage costs.

14163.title: Realigning the United States Refugee Admissions Program
14163.source: State Dept refugee program budget; HHS refugee resettlement data
14163.methodology: Suspension of refugee admissions eliminates resettlement costs (~$2.8B/yr across State, HHS, and local grants). Does not account for economic contributions of refugees or diplomatic costs.

14165.title: Securing Our Borders
14165.source: CBP budget; Army Corps of Engineers wall estimates
14165.methodology: Border wall construction ($4.2B/yr), additional CBP agents ($3.1B), military deployment to border ($2.8B), technology and surveillance systems ($2.7B). Based on DHS supplemental budget requests.

14169.title: Reevaluating and Realigning United States Foreign Aid
14169.source: USAID budget; State Dept foreign assistance data
14169.methodology: Freeze and review of all foreign aid programs. USAID annual budget ~$42B. Actual savings depend on which programs are permanently cut vs. temporarily paused. Global health programs (PEPFAR) particularly at risk.

14170.title: Reforming the Federal Hiring Process and Restoring Merit to Government Service
14170.source: OPM federal workforce data; CBO government efficiency scoring
14170.methodology: Savings from streamlined hiring and workforce reduction through attrition (~$1.9B/yr). Implementation costs include new hiring systems, legal compliance, and transition ($580M).

14171.title: Restoring Accountability to Policy-Influencing Positions Within the Federal Workforce
14171.source: OPM Schedule F analysis; CRS federal workforce report
14171.methodology: Reclassifying federal employees as at-will (Schedule F revival). Projected savings from easier termination of high-salary positions. Costs include legal challenges, severance, and institutional knowledge loss.

14173.title: Ending Illegal Discrimination and Restoring Merit-Based Opportunity
14173.source: DOJ enforcement data; EEOC budget analysis
14173.methodology: Savings from reduced federal DEI/affirmative action compliance infrastructure. Costs include DOJ enforcement of new anti-DEI policies, litigation from affected parties, and contractor compliance restructuring.

14174.title: Revocation of Certain Executive Orders
14174.source: Composite CBO analysis of revoked orders
14174.methodology: Aggregate savings from revoking 78 Biden-era executive orders. Highly uncertain — many revoked orders had minimal direct spending. Largest savings from halting unfunded climate and equity mandates.

14386.title: Strengthening United States National Defense With America's Beautiful Clean Coal Power Generation Fleet
14386.source: EIA coal plant analysis; DOE grid reliability data
14386.methodology: Subsidies and incentives to maintain aging coal fleet ($4.1B), grid reliability upgrades ($1.5B), and environmental compliance waivers resulting in future cleanup costs ($800M). Coal is currently the most expensive form of new generation per MWh.

14166.title: Application of Protecting Americans From Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act to TikTok
14166.source: DOJ enforcement estimates; FCC compliance data
14166.methodology: Federal enforcement and compliance monitoring costs. Does not account for economic impact on TikTok creators or advertising market shifts.

14157.title: Designating Cartels and Other Organizations as Foreign Terrorist Organizations
14157.source: DOD/DOJ counter-terrorism operations budget; Treasury OFAC enforcement
14157.methodology: Expanded counter-terrorism operations targeting cartels: military operations ($1.2B), Treasury sanctions enforcement ($400M), DOJ prosecution ($500M). Triggers additional intelligence and surveillance spending.

14147.title: Ending the Weaponization of the Federal Government
14147.source: DOJ reorganization estimates; Inspector General reports
14147.methodology: Costs of restructuring federal law enforcement priorities, reassigning personnel, and establishing new oversight mechanisms. Indirect costs from reduced enforcement capacity not included.
